findings.problem: Editing the profile email breaks default demo-user resolution (503 on every header-less request) and makes the seed create a second demo user.
findings.fix: Add users.seed_key (unique, 'demo'); resolve the default user and check seed existence by seed_key; DEMO_USER_EMAIL is only the initial email; add R13.2a and an API test (change email, GET /profile without header -> 200).

findings.problem: normalize_skill strips whitespace before punctuation, so ' React ,' -> 'react ' (not idempotent; breaks R3.7/P3).
findings.fix: Repeat {strip whitespace; strip edge punctuation; strip one trailing '.'} until unchanged, then alias lookup; add idempotence unit + Hypothesis check and punctuation variants in P3 strategy.

findings.problem: 'Usable target roles' undefined; a stop-token-only role gives tok(t)=∅ and division by zero.
findings.fix: U = {t : tok(t) ≠ ∅}; U = ∅ or tok(title) = ∅ -> 1/2; else max over U; split the neutral reason into two templates.

findings.problem: Project/role names in reasons depend on input order when names collide after casefold, violating P5/R3.10.
findings.fix: Group projects by casefolded name (relevant if any member is; union of shared skills; display smallest original string); roles: smallest casefolded then smallest original among best ratio; add collisions to P5 strategies.

findings.problem: R10.5 skips fingerprint matches only from another source; design skips any source and the global unique constraint forbids same-source inserts.
findings.fix: Reword R10.5 to 'matches any existing job with a different (source, external_id)'; add integration test for same-source different external_id.

findings.problem: Health body differs across sections (version field, 'ok' vs 'degraded', envelope vs health body).
findings.fix: R12.2 exempts /api/health; 200 {status:'ok',database:'ok',version}, 503 {status:'degraded',database:'unavailable',version} everywhere.

findings.problem: Status code for moving an existing Saved/Interested application to Applied is unspecified.
findings.fix: 201 only when created; 200 when transitioned or already Applied; 409 otherwise; record in R2.10/R2.11 and API tests.

findings.problem: Case-insensitive matching of short terms (go, rest, node, js, ts, py, ml, dl, r) yields false positives that inflate the resume compatibility score.
findings.fix: AMBIGUOUS_RESUME_TERMS matched case-sensitively on NFKC text using canonical casings (Go, Golang, REST, Node, JS, TS, ML, DL, R); unit tests 'go to market' and 'built REST APIs'.

findings.problem: Backend container would use the localhost DATABASE_URL from .env and cannot reach db under docker compose (breaks R11.4, brief §16).
findings.fix: Compose sets backend DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://${POSTGRES_USER:-internpilot}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-change-me}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-internpilot}; document localhost URL as host-only.

findings.problem: SQLite loads DateTime(timezone=True) values naive; comparison with aware clock.now() raises TypeError.
findings.fix: UTCDateTime TypeDecorator for all timestamp columns (require aware on bind, attach UTC on load); SQLite round-trip integration test.

findings.problem: Profile, Application, JobState, Recommendation, ResumeAnalysis and Dashboard response fields are not defined, so types/api.ts cannot mirror them exactly.
findings.fix: Add §8.3 with exact field lists per schema (as given in the review doc).

findings.problem: Rounded JSON points/ratio break exact equality.
findings.fix: Exact on Fraction values; JSON points within 0.01 of weight×ratio.

findings.problem: Source value for fixture-ingested seed_jobs.json is unstated.
findings.fix: Keep 'seed' for seed_jobs.json; 'fixture' for data/ingest/*.json.

findings.problem: Location reason says 'preferred' when the match comes from the home location.
findings.fix: 'matches your location or preferred locations'.

findings.problem: EMAIL_TAKEN and CONFLICT missing from steering codes; InvalidStatusTransition vs InvalidStatusTransitionError.
findings.fix: Add codes; use InvalidStatusTransitionError everywhere.

findings.problem: GET /applications is unpaginated against the steering rule.
findings.fix: Document the Kanban exception with a 500 cap.

findings.problem: 3.7 shows the score before scoring exists (4.4/4.9); status markers lack a legend.
findings.fix: Move score display to 4.9; add a marker legend.

findings.problem: Required DATABASE_URL conflicts with a plain pytest run.
findings.fix: conftest sets DATABASE_URL to TEST_DATABASE_URL or sqlite+pysqlite:// (StaticPool) before importing the app.

findings.problem: Jobs with no skills yield empty technical/skill sections; LLM question ids undefined.
findings.fix: Generic 3-question technical fallback; continue technical-{n} numbering.

findings.problem: Whitespace-only resume, trailing '.' in keywords, and skills normalizing to None are undefined.
findings.fix: Whitespace-only = empty; strip trailing '.'; 422 for skills normalizing to None.

findings.problem: RawBatch.items typed as bare list[dict].
findings.fix: JsonObject = dict[str, object]; list[JsonObject].

findings.problem: db port exposure unspecified.
findings.fix: ports: ['127.0.0.1:5432:5432'], documented in README.

findings.problem: job_id missing from the match_explanation field list.
findings.fix: Add job_id.
